title: First live-model v0.3-R recurrent text development transition
summary: Authorize deliberation over one bounded, text-only GPU development transition that tests whether a non-evidentiary thinker frontier guides later local dreaming and paired reconstruction; LoRA, heldout access, result-driven repair, follow-up runs, and claim promotion remain outside scope.
system_thesis: The first live GPU test should isolate the recurrent thinker-to-dream information path before adding parametric transport: public experience becomes provisional local semantic memory, an answer-blind public-evidence rule may admit exact entailed local joins as supported, a narrow thinker emits selection-only confusion, later dreaming independently re-derives a missing causal join, and a fresh final thinker reconstructs a paired decision from supported paths in the frozen text checkpoint.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim human directive requesting a pretested persistent architecture and an overnight GPU result without another wasted night.
Exact proposed population, arms, schedules, model boundary, metrics, gates, artifacts, and forbidden conclusions.
Unratified exact requested GPU and bound-analysis scope plus explicit forbidden scope.
Fail-closed durable workflow proposed for the exact transition.
Exact authoritative model-call boundary with reset, request, response, parser, and provider receipt binding.
P0 adversarial tests for request mismatch, state leakage, parser provenance, and fail-closed provider behavior.
Experiment-level scheduled/provider/parser/admission bijection and one-physical-shared-prefix accounting.
P0 tests for exact schedule reconciliation, arm attribution, shared-prefix identity, and admission linkage.
Controlling recurrent organism graph, loop, rung order, and claim boundary.
Measured atomic-read, exposure, recognition, and transport constraints.
Frozen Paper-1 honesty and verifier boundaries.
Prior measured LoRA transport and failed v5 corpus evidence motivating text-first sequencing.
Binding graph-first deliberation, independent-review, human-ratification, and GPU gate.

nodes.before: The v0.3-R causal recurrence is certified only with a scripted gold semantic dreamer.
nodes.after: A pinned frozen 32B model emits at most one provisional, provenance-bound local semantic operation from one event and a bounded semantic neighborhood.
nodes.rationale: This is the first honest model proposal path and must not inherit the gold solver's answer or derivation.

nodes.before: Live model proposals enter provisional status, but final ThinkerMachine RELEASE traverses only supported edges; no answer-blind live promotion rule is yet ratified.
nodes.after: A non-generative mechanical rule may promote only an already-proposed exact typed local join whose cited immutable public route/effect records share its declared connector and deterministically reproduce its endpoints, direction, and relation; every other proposal remains provisional.
nodes.rationale: This disposes the provisional-to-RELEASE contradiction without giving a model critic, hidden verifier, or solver proposal authority; the exact grammar remains an explicit deliberation and human-ratification gate.

nodes.before: The repaired CPU condition exercises a recurrence-probe ceiling and does not score the exact final paired goal.
nodes.after: A model-driven replayed ThinkerMachine first emits a non-answer typed frontier and, after MEMORY_1 freezes, receives only the public final question and releases a cited answer or defers.
nodes.rationale: The transition must measure both missing-edge selection and downstream paired reconstruction without a precompleted answer.

nodes.before: The proposed live recurrence has no frozen same-run transcript, RAG, or wake-only reference.
nodes.after: Full public transcript, bounded iterative episodic RAG, wake-only text memory, and CPU gold ceilings are evaluated with explicit budgets.
nodes.rationale: A small calibration world fits context, so retrieval/context competence must be measured rather than treated as failure.

nodes.before: No current workflow binds this interleaved v0.3-R transition to P0/P1, immutable reviews, remote markers, and exact human scope.
nodes.after: A material-intake-bound workflow fails closed through CPU gates, complete freeze closure, two binding reviews, persistent remote markers, artifact verification, postcommit analysis, and a human stop.
nodes.rationale: Overnight execution must survive disconnection without expanding scientific authority.

edges.before: Only the scripted ceiling closes the public operational probe.
edges.after: An allowlisted own or matched-distractor frontier selects bounded RETURN_SLEEP views but cannot be cited or written.
edges.rationale: This is the causal return edge under test and prevents answer laundering.

edges.before: No live-model recipient-local semantic snapshot reaches the exact final-goal thinker.
edges.after: Every parsed model claim enters provisional status with exact bounded-view citations; a model support flag, repetition, self-check, frontier, or private truth cannot promote it.
edges.rationale: Proposal generation and epistemic admission must be separable and auditable.

edges.before: The final ThinkerMachine cannot legally RELEASE over a corpus containing only provisional live-model edges.
edges.after: Canonical realizations preserve both statuses in MEMORY_1, but only joins mechanically admitted from exact public evidence may participate in a RELEASE support path; provisional items remain retrieval/scratch-only.
edges.rationale: The live transition can test honest proposal plus use without laundering the answer or silently making provisional claims evidentiary.

edges.before: No exact postcommit-only scoring path is bound to this transition.
edges.after: Only complete hash-verified artifacts reach offline truth scoring and result analysis; every next decision routes to a human boundary.
edges.rationale: Scoring may interpret committed behavior but cannot steer generation or authorize another experiment.

loops.before: The current CPU loop is a scripted recurrence-probe ceiling, while v5 was a non-recurrent direct-parent batch.
loops.after: For complete pair-local public schedules, run shared WAKE/reactivation/target-blind dreaming with answer-blind public-evidence admission, freeze MEMORY_0, run THINK_0, branch into no-feedback/own-agenda/matched-distractor RETURN_SLEEP under the same admission rule, freeze MEMORY_1, reveal the public final question, and run a fresh cited final thinker.
loops.trigger: One exact human-ratified development transition after every P0/P1 and immutable review gate passes.
reads: sealed public final question after MEMORY_1
writes: provisional semantic operations with eligible premises
append-only public-evidence admission decisions and supported status events
replayed thinker traces and cited terminal
loops.stop_condition: Complete every valid arm/life, invalidate on an integrity breach, and route every result or failure to a human boundary; never launch a follow-up.
loops.rationale: This is the smallest GPU loop that can discriminate whether honest cognitive feedback improves later local causal memory and paired use.

loops.before: A local session or watcher could disappear during a long model run.
loops.after: Hash-bound remote start/progress/done/failed markers are authoritative; a disposable local watchdog may resume polling and artifact transfer but cannot infer completion or duplicate the run.
loops.trigger: Both independent reviews and exact intake/lock preflight approve the same bytes.
reads: binding Fable and Sol review receipts
loops.stop_condition: Verified done/failed marker, 12-hour hard timeout, immutable-review rejection, infrastructure escalation, or mandatory post-result human gate.
loops.rationale: Persistence solves unattended execution without transferring scientific authority to the watchdog.

claims.before: Only a scripted gold recurrence demonstrates that a typed frontier could close one local causal join.
claims.after: On aligned development collision twins, an honest live model may independently close more requested recipient-local causal joins and support more cited paired releases under own feedback than under no feedback or a matched irrelevant frontier.
claims.evidence_needed: Three complete paired development seeds, exact pair-local schedules and matched arms, postcommit closure/path scoring, paired-both-correct final results, full-context/RAG/wake-only baselines, exact compute, and two immutable independent approvals.

Postcommit attribution may audit public provenance.

The thinker receives an immutable canonical checkpoint projection.

Committed structure and status are audited only after completion.
After a proposal commits, a non-generative checker recomputes one exact typed join from its cited public route/effect records; it receives no goal, answer, or oracle.
The checkpoint exposes the resulting supported/provisional status, not hidden truth or checker rationale.

No thinker exists before MEMORY_0.

Own or matched frontier selects a view but has no evidentiary force.

Postcommit analysis measures consumption and closure.
It remains separately sealed before MEMORY_1.
The intermediate operational probe is not the final task.

The public task may be reported after commitment.
Latent bit, answer, scorer path, and oracle proof are never model inputs.
The public compiler and machine have no private world object.
Feedback selection cannot contain answer-bearing state.
Private truth can never be realized or memorized.
The thinker sees only the question and declared memory interface.
A separate scorer may compare final committed predictions.
No exact or adaptive gate steers model proposals.
The thinker is replayed against public memory only.
Committed outcomes cannot be rejection-sampled in-loop.
Truth labels cannot filter the corpus.
No checker may supply a final path or answer.
It is restricted to postcommit metrics and cannot route a follow-up.

acceptance_tests.setup: Forge a self-consistent compiled checkpoint/goal, swap the own agenda projection for the registered distractor, alter retrieved/cited IDs, or rewrite a RELEASE claim while preserving self-hashes.
acceptance_tests.expected: The scheduler independently rebuilds trusted checkpoint and goal, replays raw operations, mechanically reprojects the exact agenda/result/terminal support, and rejects every forgery.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A pluggable runner can launder an answer or frontier through a self-hashed machine trace.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use a policy backend that sends different prompt/config/reset bytes than the materials the adapter proposes to ledger, misreports provider tokens, or retains conversational/KV state across resets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only one exact immutable call request reaches the provider; returned provider metadata reconciles to it; stateless reset is enforced; every mismatch fails closed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The thinker ledger is descriptive rather than authoritative at the actual model boundary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Drop, duplicate, reorder, rewrite, or leave unconsumed one DREAM call/output; alter its bounded prompt, reset, parser result, token use, or semantic decision.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every live dream has a bijective exact provider-call record, raw output, strict parse, bounded-view binding, and scope-isolated decision; any discrepancy fails.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The dream half of the purported live organism is unaudited or can fabricate parsed memory.

acceptance_tests.setup: Submit a model-proposed exact typed local join with valid cited public route/effect records, then substitute an unrelated record, a wrong or ambiguous connector, reversed direction, changed relation, invented endpoint, thinker frontier, model mark_supported flag, private/final-truth sentinel, or same-model self-check verdict.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the unchanged proposal whose immutable public citations share the declared connector and mechanically reproduce every typed endpoint/direction/relation receives an append-only supported event; all attacks remain provisional or reject. The checker never searches or proposes endpoints, never reads the final question/private world/oracle/truth, and is byte-invariant under private/final-truth mutation. A separately labeled same-model self-check ablation, if later ratified, cannot write support in this primary condition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The live corpus either cannot license any final RELEASE or obtains support through hidden-answer verification, circular self-approval, or checker-generated structure.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare arm call ledgers with a missing call, unequal prefix, changed decoding budget, cross-life reset, or unreported token use.
acceptance_tests.expected: The experiment reconciles shared prefix identity, pair/arm schedule equality, exact maximum budgets, unique resets, and actual tokens/calls before scoring.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: An apparent feedback gain may be extra compute or state contamination.

acceptance_tests.setup: Train heldout shortcut predictors over raw rendered text, event positions/order, IDs, passive signatures, single and combined public feature families, and target-only features across 1000 collision pairs.
acceptance_tests.expected: Declared ambiguity/majority gates pass and every surviving shortcut is reported before a model run.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The repaired calibration can be solved without the intended causal information path.

acceptance_tests.setup: Bind the final ThinkerMachine to the separately sealed public final question for both collision twins; remove one required edge and attempt release, or inject one twin answer/operation into the goal compiler.
acceptance_tests.expected: The exact public goal is unavailable before MEMORY_1; a complete cited path may release one schema-valid answer; missing support defers; paired scoring remains offline.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The transition still measures only an operational-probe ceiling or leaks the paired answer.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run seeds 0/1/2 collision twins and all arms, then truncate seed 1 to 46 WAKE/22 REACTIVATE, pad another life, or alter one arm count.
acceptance_tests.expected: Actual counts equal each world's public schedule_manifest; seed 0/2 use 46+22 and seed 1 uses 49+24; both twins and all arms agree within each pair; total dream calls equal 802.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A global schedule silently discards lived experience or gives arms unequal compute.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate latent bit/private pair/answer/scorer fields and final-question sentinels while capturing complete model-facing DREAM and THINK bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Pre-final model bytes are twin-invariant except for the one lived public intervention outcome; private/answer/scorer/final sentinels are absent; the final public question appears only after MEMORY_1.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The model can identify a twin or answer through metadata or early goal visibility.

acceptance_tests.setup: Give a dream more than one trigger/six neighbors, cite an out-of-view item, cite a thinker frontier, copy its desired relation without public/semantic premises, or route it to realization.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every attack fails; own and matched frontiers affect selection only, and a later edge is independently derived from eligible recipient-local premises.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The return edge is answer laundering or global graph tool use.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run full-lifetime context, bounded episodic RAG, wake-only text memory, three recurrent arms, and labeled CPU ceilings with one pinned model and explicit operation/retrieval/token budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: All required outputs and compute records exist; context/RAG success is preserved; no LoRA/oracle agenda/perfect gate enters the live transition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The causal result lacks its strongest small-context competitors or quietly attributes read/controller compute to memory.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze the complete runtime import/transitive test closure from a quiescent snapshot; hash at each review start/end; submit the exact workflow/model/prompts/budgets to fresh Fable and fresh Sol reviewers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every byte remains identical and both binding verdicts approve with no required change; mutation, omission, malformed output, reject, or escalation blocks launch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The launched program differs from reviewed evidence or one reviewer is treated as optional.

acceptance_tests.setup: Disconnect/kill the local watchdog during remote execution, retry launch/status, corrupt or omit a marker, and attempt a duplicate run with the same run ID.
acceptance_tests.expected: Remote started/progress/done/failed markers and exact artifact hashes remain authoritative; status resumes without duplicate execution; corruption or ambiguity escalates without relaunch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The overnight run depends on one chat/session or can duplicate/guess remote state.

acceptance_tests.setup: Delete, reorder, rewrite, or orphan a public input, model call, semantic event, realization, checkpoint, thinker step, baseline trace, scorer packet, metric, or trajectory export.
acceptance_tests.expected: Independent artifact verification and full SHA-256 reconciliation fail; complete untouched bundles pass.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result cannot attribute where information or performance changed.

acceptance_tests.setup: Initialize the workflow while intake is collecting/human_required, with stale evidence, or with requested LoRA/heldout/repair/follow-up/claim/external/spend scope.
acceptance_tests.expected: Initialization fails until exactly one hash-bound Rohin ratification authorizes only the two requested scope atoms; every forbidden expansion fails.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Model consensus or a broad continue instruction can self-authorize GPU science.

acceptance_tests.setup: Return every valid result-analyst decision including repair, run_frozen, replicate_frozen, stop, or escalate; attempt automatic prompt repair, transport, replication, or claim promotion.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every route stops at science_escalation/human and no scientific mutation or launch follows.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: One development result can expand into an unauthorized campaign.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two fresh interpretations and cross-critique explicitly dispose the provisional-to-supported admission concern, and after exact consensus and P0/P1 evidence bind the answer-blind public entailment grammar, authorize only gpu:v03r_live_text_recurrence_dev_v1 plus bound postcommit analysis while retaining every listed forbidden scope?
forbidden_before_approval: initialize or run the proposed workflow
same-model self-check or model-controlled support gate
prompt or code repair from results
lease, spend, credential, or second-GPU change
